title: ARK Workbench Run Provenance
description: Canonical provenance block attached to every top-level Workbench report and export.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the run started

finished_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the run finished

completion_status.description: Must be one of the four canonical statuses. 'interrupted', 'blocked', or 'failed-before-analysis' must not be presented as release certification.

certification_disclaimer.description: Present when completion_status is not 'complete', warning against using results for release certification.

git_sha.description: Git commit SHA of the code under test

app_url.description: Application base URL used during the run

environment_fingerprint.description: SHA256 hash of PHP version, OS, hostname, and APP_ENV

tenant_identity.description: Tenant fixture identity used during the run

scenario_version.description: Version of the scenario/seed data used

ai_policy.description: AI policy showing both configured and resolved provider/model

resolved_provider.description: The provider actually used (resolved from policy)

resolved_model.description: The model actually used (resolved from policy)

artifact_schema_versions.description: Map of artifact type to schema version identifier

input_artifacts.description: References to exact input artifacts consumed, with relative path and content hash

redaction_status.description: Whether any evidence or fields were redacted
